FAQs

Useful answers before you book

How much does an EPC cost?

Domestic EPC prices start from £70 for flats. Houses are £85, bungalows are £80 and maisonettes are £75. A £20 travel premium may apply outside the main Glasgow and Edinburgh postcode zones.

Can I book an EPC and Legionella assessment together?

Yes. The EPC + Legionella bundle starts from £100 when both services are booked together.

What areas do you cover?

We cover Glasgow, Edinburgh, Bearsden, Bishopbriggs and nearby Central Belt areas.

Who uses Scotland EPC?

Landlords, homeowners, sellers, letting agents and property managers use the service for property compliance paperwork.
